newsitem.title: USA: MassMutual unit closes $476 mln financing deal.
newsitem.headline: MassMutual unit closes $476 mln financing deal.

text.p: Massachusetts Mutual Life Insurance Co (MassMutual) said on Thursday it completed funding of MassMutual High Yield Partners LLC, a $476 million, actively managed private investment company.
MassMutual High Yield Partners will invest in high-yield, publicly traded bonds and leveraged bank loans.
Also, MassMutual the investment company will invest a portion of its assets into special situation assets, including distressed debt, private high-yield securities and public and private equity.

The MassMutual High Yield Partners' initial closing included the sale of $95 million of unit equity interests, $84 million of subordinated notes due 2006 and $95 million of senior secured notes due 2004, the company said.
MassMutual will serve as the investment advisor to High Yield Partners and provided approximately one-third of the invested equity, the company said.
BankAmerica Corp's BA Securities Inc served as financial advisor and exclusive placement agent in connection with each of the debt and equity issues, MassMutual said.
Also, a $202 million revolving credit facility that will be available to High Yield Partners, the company said.
